headlines.title: Netflix Just Keeps Falling: Here’s Why One Wall Street Pro Remains Resolute That 90% Await Today’s Buyers
headlines.summary: Netflix has shed more than 40% in a year while one top Wall Street analyst holds a target that towers above the crowd. The question is whether the bull case rests on a real inflection or wishful thinking about ads and live events.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) vs Spotify (SPOT): Which Subscription Stock Has a Wider Moat?
headlines.summary: Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) and Spotify Technology S.A. (NYSE:SPOT) have built two of the world’s biggest subscription businesses, but they’ve done so in very different ways. Netflix’s advantage comes largely from its scale and the amount of content it can offer.

headlines.title: Most Investors Are Wrong About Selling Netflix. Here's What I'd Do Instead.
headlines.summary: Netflix has been under pressure this year. That's not a reason to sell.

headlines.title: Netflix Stock Upgraded To Buy As Investors Miss Big Picture
headlines.summary: Deutsche Bank called a bottom to Netflix's slide, upgrading shares of the streaming video leader to buy from neutral. Netflix stock rose.

headlines.title: Netflix Stock Jumps After Deutsche Bank Upgrade on Global Opportunity
headlines.summary: Deutsche Bank Just Upgraded Netflix: Analyst Says Investors May Be Missing a Huge Global Opportunity

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
